title: Getting Started with R Programming: Install R and RStudio on Windows & Mac

cues.en: Instructor: Hello my friends, welcome to this new tutorial.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，歡迎來到新的教學。

cues.en: In this one I'm gonna show you how to install R and RStudio on your machine.
cues.zh: 這堂課示範如何在電腦安裝 R 與 RStudio。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 我們開始。

cues.en: We have to start with R.
cues.zh: 先從 R 開始。

cues.en: So, here in the search bar we're gonna type C-R-A-N, press enter, and we're gonna click the first link of the Comprehensive R Archive Network,
cues.zh: 在搜尋列輸入 CRAN，按 Enter，點第一個 Comprehensive R Archive Network 連結，

cues.en: because that's exactly where we can download and install R for the three systems: Linux, macOS, and Windows.
cues.zh: 這裡能下載並安裝適用於 Linux、macOS 與 Windows 的 R。

cues.en: So, let me show you quickly how to do it for the three, starting with Linux. Download R for Linux.
cues.zh: 先快速介紹這三種系統，從 Linux 開始，選 Download R for Linux。

cues.en: So here, make sure to choose your Linux system.
cues.zh: 請選擇自己的 Linux 發行版。

cues.en: For example, I'm gonna show this to you for Ubuntu, and then you simply need to follow the instructions here.
cues.zh: 例如，我用 Ubuntu 示範，接著依照這裡的指示操作。

cues.en: So, you open your Linux terminal, then you're gonna enter these four command lines, after which you will run this command line to install R and its dependencies, and that's it.
cues.zh: 開啟 Linux 終端機，輸入這四行指令，再執行這行指令安裝 R 及其相依套件，就完成了。

cues.en: That's all you need to do on Linux.
cues.zh: Linux 只需要這樣做。

cues.en: You just install R by running these commands.
cues.zh: 執行這些指令即可安裝 R。

cues.en: All right, so now let me show you how to do this for Windows.
cues.zh: 接著示範 Windows。

cues.en: For Windows, I recommend to click "base" here because this is the easy option if you want to install R for the first time.
cues.zh: Windows 建議點這裡的 base，第一次安裝 R 時，這是比較簡單的選項。

cues.en: So, let's do this. Let's choose this one.
cues.zh: 選這一個。

cues.en: And then you simply click this link to install the latest R version.
cues.zh: 再點這個連結，安裝最新版 R。

cues.en: You might get a different one when you take this tutorial.
cues.zh: 你上課時看到的版本可能不同。

cues.en: At the time I'm speaking it is 4.2.2, all right?
cues.zh: 我錄製時的版本是 4.2.2。

cues.en: I'm on a Mac, so I'm not gonna download here, and well, speaking of Mac, I'm gonna show you now how to download R for macOS.
cues.zh: 我使用 Mac，所以不在這裡下載；現在就示範 macOS 的下載方法。

cues.en: So, we click this link here, then we're gonna take the latest release again, and then make sure here to select the right PKG file according to your macOS system.
cues.zh: 點這個連結，同樣選最新版，再依自己的 macOS 系統，選對 PKG 檔。

cues.en: So, for macOS 11 Big Sur and higher, Apple silicon arm64, this is what you want, and then for macOS 10.13 High Sierra and higher, Intel 64-bit, this is what you want.
cues.zh: macOS 11 Big Sur 以上、Apple Silicon arm64 選這個；macOS 10.13 High Sierra 以上、Intel 64 位元選這個。

cues.en: So, as far as I'm concerned, I'm in this case, and so I'm gonna click this link to download the version 4.2.2 of R, and so I'm gonna click "save," and this will download R.
cues.zh: 我的電腦屬於這一類，所以點這個連結下載 R 4.2.2，再按 Save。

cues.en: There we go, it was very fast.
cues.zh: 好了，下載很快。

cues.en: So, now I'm gonna go to my Downloads folder, I'm gonna double click it, and then we're just gonna click "continue" here to install R on our machine.
cues.zh: 接著到 Downloads 資料夾，按兩下安裝檔，再按 Continue，安裝 R。

cues.en: Agree and install. There we go.
cues.zh: 同意，再安裝。好了。

cues.en: And now it is installing R, and perfect.
cues.zh: 現在正在安裝 R，很好。

cues.en: Installation was successful. Great.
cues.zh: 安裝成功。

cues.en: So, now you have R on your machine.
cues.zh: 現在電腦上已經有 R 了。

cues.en: That's great, but we want an easy interface, you know, a very user friendly interface when coding with R and that's why it's also very good to install RStudio.
cues.zh: 很好，但我們希望有一個方便、友善的 R 程式介面，所以最好也安裝 RStudio。

cues.en: So, we're gonna go back to our favorite browser and this time we're gonna enter RStudio. There we go.
cues.zh: 回到瀏覽器，這次搜尋 RStudio。

cues.en: RStudio, you click the first link and you're gonna download RStudio, so let's click this link first.
cues.zh: 點第一個連結，準備下載 RStudio，先進入這裡。

cues.en: There we go, the RStudio ID, that's exactly what we want, and we're gonna take the RStudio desktop.
cues.zh: RStudio IDE，這正是我們要的，選 RStudio Desktop。

cues.en: So, let's click "Download RStudio" again, and let's scroll down and let's find the right one for our system.
cues.zh: 再點 Download RStudio，往下捲，找到適合自己系統的版本。

cues.en: So, download and install R, We've already done it on CRAN, and if you scroll down you will find RStudio for your system.
cues.zh: 第一步是下載並安裝 R，剛才已透過 CRAN 完成；再往下就能找到各系統的 RStudio。

cues.en: Alright, Windows, macOS, Ubuntu, Ubuntu 22, and some more below.
cues.zh: 包括 Windows、macOS、Ubuntu、Ubuntu 22，下面還有其他版本。

cues.en: Okay, so here I'm on a Mac, so again, I'm gonna take this one then save.
cues.zh: 我使用 Mac，所以選這個，再按 Save。

cues.en: Done. So, now I'm gonna go back to my download folder, I'm gonna double click this one now, I'm gonna put it in my applications, and in a second I will have RStudio installed on my machine.
cues.zh: 完成。回到下載資料夾，按兩下這個檔案，拖進 Applications，很快就會安裝好 RStudio。

cues.en: So, let's close this, and now let's open RStudio and let me introduce you to it.
cues.zh: 關閉這裡，再打開 RStudio，介紹它的介面。

cues.en: So, I'm gonna find it right here.
cues.zh: 我在這裡找到它。

cues.en: Open and welcome to RStudio.
cues.zh: 開啟，歡迎來到 RStudio。

cues.en: All right, so first we can see that RStudio is divided into three panels.
cues.zh: 首先可以看到，RStudio 分成三個面板。

cues.en: This panel here, which is the console where you can execute some code, like for example, two plus two and press "Enter."
cues.zh: 這是 Console，可以執行程式，例如輸入 2+2，再按 Enter。

cues.en: Then, this is the environment panel where the variables of your code will be created when you execute it, and then the third panel here, which is your files, you know, from your computer,
cues.zh: 這裡是 Environment，程式執行時建立的變數會顯示在這裡；第三個是本機檔案面板，

cues.en: where you can access your codes and your data set.
cues.zh: 可以存取程式與資料集。

cues.en: So, for example, let's go to my desktop where I have the whole Machine Learning A to Z Codes and Datasets folder, and let's enter it.
cues.zh: 例如，進入桌面上完整的 Machine Learning A-Z Codes and Datasets 資料夾。

cues.en: Let's take, for example, Part 2 - Regression and the simplest model, Simple Linear Regression, and then the R folder.
cues.zh: 以 Part 2 Regression、最簡單的 Simple Linear Regression，再進入 R 資料夾為例。

cues.en: So, here you can find the code of the Simple Linear Regression model, the R code, right?
cues.zh: 這裡有簡單線性迴歸模型的 R 程式。

cues.en: And then the dataset Salary_Data.csv.
cues.zh: 以及 Salary_Data.csv 資料集。

cues.en: So, to open the model, you simply click on it.
cues.zh: 要開啟模型，只要點一下。

cues.en: It will appear here in a fourth panel where you can edit the code in this R file, right?
cues.zh: 它會出現在第四個面板，可以編輯這份 R 程式。

cues.en: So now, just for fun, just to give us an exciting introductory note on R, let's execute this code, but before we execute it, the first thing we always have to do
cues.zh: 現在先好玩地執行一下，讓你對 R 有個有趣的初步印象。不過，執行前一定要先

cues.en: is to set this folder as working directory folder so that when we import the data set here while the console knows where to access it,
cues.zh: 把這個資料夾設為工作目錄，這樣匯入資料集時，Console 才知道去哪裡找。

cues.en: which is in this folder, and so to set this folder as working directory, we simply click "More" here and then set as working directory.
cues.zh: 資料就在這個資料夾，所以點 More，再選 Set As Working Directory。

cues.en: There we go, and now we can simply select the whole code here and then press Command or Control+Enter to execute it, and there we go.
cues.zh: 好了，現在選取全部程式，按 Command 或 Control 加 Enter 執行。

cues.en: As you can see now, the code is executing in the console and soon enough we can see our variables in the environment, all the variables that are in this code,
cues.zh: 可以看到，程式正於 Console 執行，很快 Environment 就會出現程式中使用的全部變數，

cues.en: and the two plots of the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 也會畫出訓練集與測試集的兩張圖。

cues.en: Of course, all these steps will be explained in details when we implement the Simple Linear Regression model.
cues.zh: 之後實作簡單線性迴歸時，會逐步說明全部操作。

cues.en: This was just a teaser of what we're gonna do in R, and speaking of which, I'll look forward to seeing you in the next Practical Activities on Python and R to implement R models,
cues.zh: 這只是先預告 R 裡會做什麼；接下來的 Python 與 R 實作課，我們再一起建立模型。

cues.en: and until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
